scope: Durable trusted-host unittest process/count/source-byte records; not engineering acceptance

verification.scope: Local process/test counts and selected source-byte correspondence; not engineering acceptance or authenticated provenance

controls: Actual passing and skipped callback counts remain distinct
Failed subtests retain multiple failures for one test
Class setup error with zero executed tests remains failed
Source changed by a controlled child invalidates current pass
Changed log or missing terminal receipt rejects
Repeated worker cannot overwrite terminal result
